notes:
Topline: Apex Lane is an ad-tech DSP evaluating Redwood Dedicated for real-time model inference (reranking + bidding decisions). They need guaranteed sustained throughput with predictable burst behavior for major campaigns.

Throughput/Capacity asks (from AE/SE convo):
- Baseline guaranteed tokens/sec: 25,000 tokens/sec sustained across EU+NA (business asks baseline SLA).
- Burst policy: allow up to 100,000 tokens/sec for 10 minutes per campaign window (x3 per day) with explicit warm-up plan (pre-warm KV cache).
- Concurrency caps: prefer soft concurrency cap at 800 concurrent calls, hard cap 1200 (policy for throttling).
- Reserved GPU plan: initial commit 8x A100/H100-class GPUs (multi-node), ability to burst to 12 GPUs during campaign windows; want reserved slots for model variants (quantized vs fp16).
- Latency SLOs: 95th percentile request latency < 200ms for short requests (<512 tokens); 99th < 500ms with fallback rules.
- Fallback routing: must support automatic fallback to smaller variant (e.g., 2x quantized model) with <50ms added latency and explicit routing policy.
- Billing: committed monthly baseline + overage per-token beyond baseline; legal wants an overage cap and clear credit formula for SLA misses.

Security/Compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, KMS integration for model keys, audit logs for inference calls. EU data residency for cached prefixes is a hard ask (some clients are EU-only).

POC plan agreed: 2-week synthetic replay + 1-week live traffic ramp. Tasks: perf harness from SE, synthetic traces from Apex Lane, Deploy dedicated pool in eu-west and us-east, run soak, produce token/sec curve + latency CDF.

AE notes (Marissa): "They were clear: predictable economics > absolute lowest price. If we can guarantee baseline throughput and a simple burst policy, we close. Legal will drive SLA wording."

SE notes (Diego): "Initial perf run hit 28k sustained with 8x A100 but 95p latency spikes at peak; need kernel/concurrency tuning and KV pre-warm. We'll propose warm-up API and a 10-min pre-burst reservation window."
